milestones.name: Acquire Dream Nail
milestones.note: Prerequisite to fighting Elder Hu at his memorial

milestones.name: Defeat Elder Hu
milestones.note: Spirit shatters into 100 Essence collected by the Dream Nail

milestones.name: Collect 100 Essence from Elder Hu
milestones.note: Rewarded upon defeating Elder Hu's spirit

milestones.name: Acquire Love Key
milestones.note: Found on a corpse in the southeast of the Queen's Gardens above the path to the Fungal Wastes; requires Isma's Tear

milestones.name: Acquire Isma's Tear
milestones.note: Required to retrieve the Love Key in Queen's Gardens

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.note: Zone context for this segment; Elder Hu's memorial is located here

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.note: Location where the Love Key is found, southeast area above path to Fungal Wastes

zones.name: Fungal Wastes
zones.note: Area below the Love Key location in Queen's Gardens; path leads from Queen's Gardens

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.note: Location where the Love Key can be used

abilities.name: Dream Nail
abilities.note: Required to fight Elder Hu's spirit and to collect Essence upon his defeat

abilities.name: Shade Cloak
abilities.note: Highly recommended for dodging Elder Hu's Ring Slam and Ring Curtain attacks; not completely necessary

abilities.name: Howling Wraiths
abilities.note: Spell usable with Shade Cloak build to quickly defeat Elder Hu

abilities.name: Abyss Shriek
abilities.note: Spell usable with Shade Cloak build to quickly defeat Elder Hu; upgrade of Howling Wraiths

abilities.name: Isma's Tear
abilities.note: Required to retrieve the Love Key from its location in southeast Queen's Gardens

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.note: Found on a corpse in southeast Queen's Gardens above path to Fungal Wastes; used in City of Tears

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Dream boss fought at his memorial; has Ring Slam, Ring Curtain, and Teleport attacks; drops 100 Essence on defeat

objectives.name: Fight Elder Hu's spirit
objectives.hopDescription: Obtain the Dream Nail, then visit Elder Hu's memorial in Forgotten Crossroads to trigger and defeat his spirit
objectives.note: Shade Cloak recommended; dodge Ring Slam and Ring Curtain, attack in between; can also use Howling Wraiths/Abyss Shriek with Spell build

objectives.name: Collect Essence from Elder Hu
objectives.hopDescription: Use the Dream Nail to collect 100 Essence after Elder Hu shatters

objectives.name: Retrieve the Love Key
objectives.hopDescription: Acquire Isma's Tear, then travel to the southeast of Queen's Gardens above the path to Fungal Wastes to collect the Love Key from a corpse

objectives.name: Use Love Key in City of Tears
objectives.hopDescription: Bring the Love Key to its corresponding lock location in the City of Tears
objectives.note: Exact use location is in the City of Tears

connectors.description: Path leads from Queen's Gardens southeast area down to Fungal Wastes
connectors.note: Love Key is found above this path in Queen's Gardens

connectors.description: Love Key retrieved from Queen's Gardens is used in the City of Tears
connectors.note: Logical item-use connector; Love Key unlocks something in City of Tears
